item.title: Food Tour and History Walk of Montclair — Sat Sep 12, 1:00 PM — Crane Park
item.description: Explore Montclair, NJ on this immersive food tour showcasing a hyperlocal culinary hotspot, co-hosted by Chow Town Food Tours and Montclair History Center. “Montclair In Motion” is a social, flavorful experience rooted in this colorful community’s unique industrial history and more recent cultural growth, including culinary traditions from Argentina, the Philippines, Sicily, West Africa, and Brazil. Chow Town Food Tours and the Montclair History Center will provide expert insights for a tour to remember. This guided exploration of Bloomfield Avenue will lead guests on a leisurely one-mile walk, stopping for Brazilian comfort food, humongous cookies, and more. Meet the chefs and business owners that make this one of the most exciting restaurant scenes in the state. Discover the hidden history behind architecture, landmarks, and other notable highlights from the experts at the nonprofit Montclair History Center. Bring an appetite! item.title: Charcoal Drawing for Non-Artists NEW — Thu Sep 17, 10:30 AM — Montclair Main - Conference Room
item.description:
Join us at the Montclair Public Library for an afternoon that will change the way you think about drawing. Working from fresh flowers, fruit, and carefully curated objects, participants will learn the timeless techniques artists use to create realistic tonal drawings with charcoal. This workshop regularly leaves participants surprised by what they are capable of creating in just one session.
More than a drawing class, it's an introduction to the art of looking—a skill that can be practiced and enjoyed for years to come. If you're not easily impressed by your artistic abilities, prepare to surprise yourself. All skills levels and self-proclaimed "non-artists" are welcome. A little charcoal dust is part of the experience, so wearing an old shirt is recommended.
Source: Libcal Bccls 10306

item.title: Theater League of Clifton Announces Auditions for “1776” — Thu Sep 17, 7:00 PM — NJ
item.description: The Theater League of Clifton will hold auditions for its upcoming production of “1776” on Tuesday, September 15; Wednesday, September 16; and Thursday, September 17, from 7:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. Callbacks by invitation may also be held Thursday, September 17. Auditions will be held at Living Hope, 303 Maplewood Ave., Clifton, NJ 07013. Performances will be held November 13, 14 and 15 at the Wayne Community Center, 1 Pike Drive, Wayne, NJ. The production will be directed by Maren Sugarman. With music and lyrics by Sherman Edwards and a book by Peter Stone, 1776 dramatizes the struggle within the Second Continental Congress to declare American independence. John Adams, Benjamin Franklin and Thomas Jefferson attempt to persuade a divided Congress to break with England while political, regional and personal conflicts threaten to derail the effort.
